scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=hub-api" "npm run dev --workspace=dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=hub-api && npm run build --workspace=dashboard
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const{existsSync}=require('fs');if(existsSync('vendor/rea/package.json')&&!existsSync('vendor/rea/dist/cli-runtime/cli.js')){console.log('[zpond] building vendor/rea...');require('child_process').execSync('npm ci && npm run build:cached',{cwd:'vendor/rea',stdio:'inherit'})} }catch(e){console.error('[zpond postinstall] skipped:',e.message)}"
scripts.setup:vendor: npm ci --prefix vendor/rea && npm run build:cached --prefix vendor/rea
